Status.note: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists Osawatomie plant 7928, generator 1, as operating with 102.0 MW nameplate and an operating year of 2003. units.notes: The unit is still operating in the August 2026 EIA table with no retirement date. I searched the web and found no news of a retirement, mothballing or sale.
